text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Sweepâª Happy, happy 
birthday~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I hope you like the present, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A present? You mean this letter? I haven't 
read it yet, but—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ That's actually an invitation, not 
just a letter!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I found a lovely, warm 
sunbathing spot in the sunshine. I was 
thinking of inviting Sweep-san along~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~ sunbathing? That sounds kinda 
boring...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all! It's truly wonderful, 
with so many beautiful flowers!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cherry blossoms in spring, oak flowers in 
early summer, and cosmos in autumn! See? 
It's a full lineup representing the Triple 
Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
There are all kinds of little flowers like 
dandelions here. I bet some of the 
medicinal herbs Sweep-san is looking for 
are among them!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If so many are growing, we might even find 
magical ingredients that Grandma doesn't 
know about...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Not bad, Craft! Very well, Magical Girl 
Sweepy shall grace your secret herb garden 
with her presence!
